article.headline: Pacers visit Cavaliers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.description: Indiana Pacers (5-10, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (8-8, seventh in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Pacers visit Cavaliers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.linkText: Pacers visit Cavaliers Friday in NBA Cup group stage
article.story: Indiana Pacers (5-10, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (8-8, seventh in the Eastern Conference) Cleveland; Friday, 7:30 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: The Cleveland Cavaliers play the Indiana Pacers in an NBA Cup in-season tournament group play matchup. The Cavaliers are 6-5 in conference games. Cleveland is seventh in the Eastern Conference with 27.5 assists per game led by James Harden averaging 6.3. The Pacers are 0-1 against opponents in the Central Division. Indiana ranks second in the Eastern Conference scoring 51.3 points per game in the paint led by Pascal Siakam averaging 11.1. The Cavaliers' 15.1 made 3-pointers per game this season are only 0.6 more made shots on average than the 14.5 per game the Pacers allow. The Pacers average 11.7 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.3 fewer made shots on average than the 14.0 per game the Cavaliers allow. TOP PERFORMERS: Donovan Mitchell is averaging 24.8 points and 5.3 assists for the Cavaliers. Harden is averaging 14.3 points over the last 10 games. Andrew Nembhard is averaging 16.6 points and 7.6 assists for the Pacers. Siakam is averaging 20.4 points and 4.3 rebounds while shooting 50.0% over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Cavaliers: 4-6, averaging 116.6 points, 44.5 rebounds, 26.8 assists, 7.4 steals and 4.4 blocks per game while shooting 47.5% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 116.5 points per game. Pacers: 3-7, averaging 109.8 points, 39.8 rebounds, 26.7 assists, 8.2 steals and 4.1 blocks per game while shooting 47.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 114.8 points. INJURIES: Cavaliers: Peyton Watson: day to day (back), Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Evan Mobley: out (toe), Jaylon Tyson: day to day (ankle). Pacers: Tyrese Haliburton: out (hamstring), Ben Sheppard: out (meniscus), Johnny Furphy: out for season (acl), Andrew Nembhard: day to day (hip). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
